dedupe_keys.name: london fire brigade incident records and mobilisation records london datastore

description: This dataset records every incident attended by the London Fire Brigade since 1 January 2009, together with a companion file of mobilisations that lists each fire engine sent to each incident. It is published by the London Fire Brigade through the Greater London Authority's London Datastore to support transparency and local analysis. Coverage is the 33 London boroughs, with one row per incident giving date and time, incident group and type (fire, special service, false alarm), property category, borough and ward, a coarsened location, the first and second pump attendance times and the number of pumps and pump hours; the mobilisation file adds the station each appliance came from and its turnout and travel times. Both files are refreshed every month and are free to download as zipped CSV or Excel under the UK Open Government Licence. Caveats: exact addresses are suppressed for dwellings, older years are split into separate files, and attendance times cover only fire engines, not specialist appliances or the London Ambulance Service. Simulation uses: calibrating fire station location and emergency response models, estimating demand by hour and area, and testing station closure or resilience scenarios. Related records: the England fire incident-level datasets (data-england-fire-incident-level-datasets) give the national counterpart and the San Francisco fire and EMS calls (data-sf-fire-ems-calls-for-service) a comparable city feed.
